name: ignis/runtime
description: PHP userland for the Ignis application server: the fiber scheduler (Ignis\Loop, async/all/sleep/deadline), the symfony/runtime adapter, the Revolt driver, the PostgreSQL pool and the offload client. Requires the ignis binary; does nothing under php-fpm or php-cli.

suggest.symfony/runtime: Set APP_RUNTIME=Ignis\Symfony\IgnisRuntime in .env and point ignis.toml's entry at public/index.php.
suggest.revolt/event-loop: REVOLT_DRIVER=Ignis\Revolt\IgnisDriver runs AMPHP on the Ignis reactor.
